headline: Binance Attributes $6.34 Billion Cyberattack to North Korea and Boosts AI Security
summary: Binance disclosed that its security team detected and prevented 57 North Korea-linked cyber threat cases totaling $6.34 billion throughout 2026, prompting investments in AI security measures.
why: Cryptocurrency exchanges face systemic cybersecurity risks from state-sponsored threat actors, making loss prevention and platform security critical operational metrics.

impacts.name: Binance
impacts.why: Exposure to multi-billion-dollar state-backed threats highlights platform security challenges.
